summary: JinkoSolar Holding filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice of its 2026 annual general meeting scheduled for October 21, 2026 in Shanghai, with a record date of September 21, 2026. Agenda items include re-electing independent directors Gang Chu and Steven Markscheid, ratifying PricewaterhouseCoopers Zhong Tian LLP as auditors for fiscal 2026, authorizing auditor remuneration, and changing the English name to Jinko Holdings Limited. A separate press release references a strategic investment update but discloses no transaction terms. This is a routine AGM notice and proxy solicitation, not a special situation; watch for any strategic-investment detail disclosed alongside the meeting.
